sentences.en: I'll have you all speaking fluent English within a year.
sentences.zh: 我保证一年之内你们都能说一口流利的英语。

sentences.en: Mr Nakajima can, as well as English, speak fluent German.
sentences.zh: 中岛先生不仅会讲英语，还会讲一口流利的德语。

sentences.en: Melissa became fluent in Portuguese in less than two years.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎不到两年就掌握了葡萄牙语，说得非常流利。

senses.zh: （说话）流利的；（表达思想）熟练的，流畅的；（做事）娴熟的；畅流的，能流动的
